title: Fisher-Price Recalls 4-in-1 Rock 'n Glide Soothers After Four Infant Deaths; 2-in-1 Soothe 'n Play Gliders Also Recalled
summary: Infants who are placed unrestrained in the product and later found on their stomach are at risk of suffocation. Units: Approximately 120,000 4-in-1 Rock 'n Glide Soothers and 55,000 2-in-1 Soothe 'n Play Gliders and approximately 27,000 2-in-1 Soothe 'n Play Gliders were also distributed in Canada.

title: Kalorik Recalls Electric Steakhouse Grills Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Incorrectly electroplated knobs on the grills can pose an electric shock hazard to users after the grill has fully preheated. Units: About 3,525 (In addition, about 71 were sold in Canada).

title: Cove Appliance Recalls Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heating element in the dishwasher can fail to properly shut off and can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 42,000.

title: Blue Star Trading Recalls Children's Fishing Toy Games Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The metal rollers on the bottom of the flying dinosaur figures contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 300.

title: BRP Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering knuckle can detach from the lower arm, resulting in a loss of control of the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 4,600.

title: CamelBak Recalls Caps Sold with Podium and Peak Fitness Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A small silicone valve in caps sold with the Podium and Peak Fitness water bottle can come loose and detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 46,000 (In addition, about 13,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Non-Contact Voltage Testers Recalled by Klein Tools Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The on/off button can remain depressed during the power on or power off cycle, causing the tester to work improperly. Consumers testing electrical sources could fail to be warned of the presence of live voltage if the tester is not properly operating, posing a shock hazard to the users. Units: About

title: Children's Nightgowns Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard; Manufactured by Auranso Official
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 8,000.

title: Children's Nightgowns Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard; Manufactured by Booph
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 4,900.

title: Children's Robes Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard; Manufactured by SIORO
summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 950.

title: UPPAbaby Recalls Adapters Included with RumbleSeats Due to Child Fall Hazard
summary: The adapters can detach, posing a fall hazard to the child in the RumbleSeat. Units: About 86,000.

title: Gramr Recalls Brushed Gold Tea Kettles Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The kettles can expel hot water and/or excessive steam during use, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 92,135 (In addition, about 12,865 units in Canada).

title: La Paloma Recalls Girls' Nightgowns Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled children's nightgowns fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 70.

title: Plant Guru Recalls Wintergreen, Birch and Blends of Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 25
